prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: Spain gallery documentary master. Create a wide 16:9 full-frame night photograph of Deià, Mallorca at 01:14 local time on 24 September 2026. Real public Ma-10 roadside overlook southeast of the village, eye-level looking northwest across the steep terraced settlement. Recognizable anchors: tightly packed ochre limestone houses with terracotta roofs stepping up the slope; Sant Joan Baptista church and modest bell tower crowning the village; dark rugged Serra de Tramuntana rock, olive terraces and slender cypress trees around it. Calm clear night, deep navy-black sky, warm restrained window and street lighting as artistic precedent only, realistic low-light exposure. No sea, moon, stars, Milky Way, people, cars, signs, fantasy castle, duplicate church tower, modern skyline, exaggerated HDR, text, logos or watermark. Natural stone texture and subdued colour. Compose the village and church centrally enough for a coherent 4:5 crop.
